svg.title: How a plugin reaches Hylo
svg.desc: A plugin package declares entry points in its pyproject.toml, for example a guard named examples.slow_zone. The plugin registry in hylo-core finds it by name, with its contract version and maturity, and experiment configs use it by that name in hylo run and hylo evolve. This repository holds five example plugins: a guard, a gate test, an online learner and two policies.
